title: Find and Identify
description: Combine kdo/co questions, To je… answers, and ten/ta/to noun chunks in short encounters.

exercises.prompt: Turn the pieces into a useful exchange

data.heading: Look → choose kdo/co → identify
data.body: First decide whether the unknown item is a person or a thing. Ask one short question, answer with To je…, and retrieve the noun with its ten, ta, or to cue when the context points to a particular item.

items.en: What is that? — an animal or thing

items.cz: To je ten stůl. / ta kniha. / to okno.
items.say: To je ten stůl. To je ta kniha. To je to okno.
items.en: Keep the learned cue with a particular noun.

exercises.prompt: Identify a visitor and an animal

data.prompt_en: Listen for a who question and a what question.
data.transcript_cz: Dobrý den. Kdo je to? To je pan Novák. A co je to? To je pes.

data.prompt_en: Listen for the noun cues. Which item comes second?
data.transcript_cz: Co je to? To je ten stůl. A co je to? To je ta kniha. A co je to? To je to okno.

exercises.prompt: Match each identification to its meaning

data.explanation: The cue belongs to the Czech noun chunk; it does not follow English gender.

exercises.answer_key: ten muž–that man; ta žena–that woman; to dítě–that child; ten pes–that dog; ta kniha–that book; to auto–that car

exercises.prompt: A classmate points to a book and asks Co je to? What fits?

data.question_cz: Spolužák ukazuje na knihu. Jak odpovíte?
data.question_en: A classmate points to a book. How do you answer?
data.explanation: Answer with To je… and retrieve kniha with its feminine cue ta.

exercises.prompt: Complete a person question, a thing question, and an answer

data.sentence: ___ je to? To je Eva. · ___ je to? ___ je auto.
data.explanation: Kdo asks about Eva, co asks about the car, and To je… starts the answer.

data.translation_en: What is that? That is the car.
data.explanation: The first to closes the question. The second to is the neuter cue for auto.

exercises.answer_key: Co je to? To je to auto.

exercises.prompt: Listen and type the person exchange

data.expected_text: Kdo je to? To je Anna.
data.note: Notice the reversed order je to in the question and To je in the answer.

exercises.answer_key: Kdo je to? To je Anna.

data.target_text: To je ten dům, ta káva a to auto.
data.translation_en: That is the house, the coffee, and the car.

exercises.answer_key: To je ten dům, ta káva a to auto.

exercises.prompt: Read labels from a classroom table

data.prompt_en: Which labels are people, and which noun cue is used for each thing?
data.text_cz:
Kdo je to? To je učitel Daniel. To je studentka Sofia.

Co je to? To je ten stůl. To je ta kniha. To je to okno.
data.text_en:
Who is that? That is the teacher Daniel. That is the student Sofia.

What is that? That is the table. That is the book. That is the window.

questions.question_en: Which three cues appear with the objects?

exercises.answer_key: Daniel and Sofia; ten, ta, to

data.scenario: A classmate shows you a photo and three objects
data.explanation: Start with kdo for Klára, then use To je… to identify the book and window.

exercises.answer_key: Kdo je to? | To je ta kniha. | To je to okno.

exercises.prompt: Write three labels for your own surroundings

data.prompt_en: Choose three visible people or things. Write three short To je… sentences. For familiar nouns, include the learned ten, ta, or to cue.
data.prompt_cz: Napište tři krátké věty s To je…
data.sample_answer: To je ten stůl. To je ta kniha. To je to okno.

exercises.answer_key: To je ten stůl. To je ta kniha. To je to okno.
